shortDescription: Robinhood CEO Tenev Vladimir sold 240,834 company shares on September 22 at an average price of $125.33 per share, according to SEC filings. According to ChainCatcher, the transaction was worth about $30.18 million, and his direct holdings fell to 6,907 shares after the sale.
